input.subject: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay – washing machine (ref R/PM041-1)
input.body:
Dear Miles,

Thank you for your email about the washing machine at Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ6 1ZZ (ref R/PM041-1), and for passing the details to Amelia.

For Amelia's information: the tenant has tried clearing the drain pump/filter as advised, twice, and the machine still does not spin or drain at the end of the cycle (it stays at "0:01" and the door stays locked until it is drained manually). So it may not be a simple pump blockage; the sink spigot issue from May 2023 may be worth checking too.

When Amelia has arranged a visit, please could you let us know the date so we can keep our records up to date?

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay – washing machine (ref R/PM041-1)
input.body:
Hi Turner,

Thanks for trying the drain pump steps and letting us know it hasn't fixed the problem. We've passed this on to your landlord so that Amelia knows before she attends.

Amelia should be in touch with you directly to arrange access. In the meantime, please avoid running the machine with a full load so water doesn't get trapped in the drum again. If you haven't heard from her by Friday 27 September, we'll chase this up with your landlord.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
